# System triggers

## Clipboard changed

Runs when the text you copied (Ctrl+C) changes. You must switch on "Watch clipboard" on the Hotkeys page first, or it never runs.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Text contains** | Only run when the copied text has this in it, like "https://". Empty means any copied text. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%clipboardText%` | The text that was just copied |

<small>Type id: `desktop.clipboardChanged`</small>

## File changed

Runs when a file in a folder you watch is changed. You set up what to watch on the Watchers page. Good for reacting to a text file another program writes.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Watcher** | The name of a folder watcher from the Watchers page. Empty means every watcher. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fileName%` | The file's name, like "score.txt" |
| `%filePath%` | The full location of the file on your computer |
| `%folder%` | The folder the file is in |
| `%fileSize%` | How big the file is, in bytes (small text files only) |
| `%lineCount%` | How many lines the file has (small text files only) |
| `%line0%` | The first line of the file (line1 is the second, and so on) |
| `%watcherName%` | The name of the watcher that noticed |

<small>Type id: `core.fileChanged`</small>

## File created

Runs when a new file appears in a folder you watch. You set up what to watch on the Watchers page. Good for reacting to a new screenshot or recording.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Watcher** | The name of a folder watcher from the Watchers page. Empty means every watcher. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fileName%` | The new file's name, like "clip.mp4" |
| `%filePath%` | The full location of the file on your computer |
| `%folder%` | The folder the file is in |
| `%watcherName%` | The name of the watcher that noticed |

<small>Type id: `core.fileCreated`</small>

## File deleted

Runs when a file is deleted from a folder you watch. You set up what to watch on the Watchers page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Watcher** | The name of a folder watcher from the Watchers page. Empty means every watcher. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fileName%` | The deleted file's name |
| `%filePath%` | The full location the file had |
| `%folder%` | The folder the file was in |
| `%watcherName%` | The name of the watcher that noticed |

<small>Type id: `core.fileDeleted`</small>

## File renamed

Runs when a file in a folder you watch gets a new name. You set up what to watch on the Watchers page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Watcher** | The name of a folder watcher from the Watchers page. Empty means every watcher. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%fileName%` | The new name of the file |
| `%oldFileName%` | The name it had before |
| `%filePath%` | The full new location of the file |
| `%oldFilePath%` | The full old location of the file |
| `%watcherName%` | The name of the watcher that noticed |

<small>Type id: `core.fileRenamed`</small>

## File tail line

Runs for each new line that a program adds to the end of a text file you follow, like a game's log. You choose the file on the Watchers page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Watcher** | The name of a file tail from the Watchers page. Empty means every file tail. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%line%` | The new line of text |
| `%fileName%` | The name of the file |
| `%filePath%` | The full location of the file |
| `%watcherName%` | The name of the file tail that noticed |

<small>Type id: `core.fileTailLine`</small>

## Hotkey pressed

Runs when you press a keyboard shortcut. You make shortcuts on the Hotkeys page, or you can type a combination like Ctrl+Shift+F1 here.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Hotkey** | A hotkey name from the Hotkeys page, or keys like "Ctrl+Shift+F1". Empty means any hotkey. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%hotkeyName%` | The name of the hotkey from the Hotkeys page |
| `%hotkey%` | The keys that were pressed, like Ctrl+Shift+F1 |
| `%key%` | The main key, without Ctrl/Alt/Shift |
| `%hasCtrl%` | True if Ctrl was held |
| `%hasAlt%` | True if Alt was held |
| `%hasShift%` | True if Shift was held |

<small>Type id: `hotkeys.pressed`</small>

## Mouse click

Runs when you click a mouse button anywhere on your computer. It does not work on Wayland (a Linux desktop type), because that blocks other programs from seeing clicks.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Button** | Which mouse button counts. Any means all of them. X1 and X2 are the extra side buttons. Options: Any, Left, Right, Middle, X1, X2. Starts as: `Left`. |
| **Modifier keys** | Keys that must be held while clicking, like "Ctrl+Shift". Empty = does not matter. "None" = no key held. Otherwise exactly the keys you list. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%mouseButton%` | Which button was clicked, like Left |
| `%mouseX%` | How far from the left of the screen the click was, in pixels |
| `%mouseY%` | How far from the top of the screen the click was, in pixels |
| `%modifiers%` | Which keys were held during the click, like Ctrl+Shift |

<small>Type id: `input.mouseClick`</small>

## Process started

Runs when a program you watch starts on your computer, like your game. You choose which programs to watch on the Watchers page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Watcher** | The name of a process watcher from the Watchers page. Empty means every process watcher. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%processName%` | The name of the program that started |
| `%processId%` | The number the computer gave this running program |
| `%path%` | The folder the program lives in (when Cuebot can find it) |
| `%watcherName%` | The name of the watcher that noticed |

<small>Type id: `core.processStarted`</small>

## Process stopped

Runs when a program you watch closes, like your game. You choose which programs to watch on the Watchers page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Watcher** | The name of a process watcher from the Watchers page. Empty means every process watcher. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%processName%` | The name of the program that closed |
| `%processId%` | The number the computer had given this program |
| `%watcherName%` | The name of the watcher that noticed |

<small>Type id: `core.processStopped`</small>

## Toast notification clicked

Runs when you click a pop-up notification that Cuebot showed with "Show desktop notification". Handy for a notification that acts like a button.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Notification id** | The notification id you typed in "Show desktop notification", like "raid-alert". Empty means any notification. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%toastId%` | The id of the notification you clicked |
| `%toastTitle%` | The title shown on the notification |
| `%toastMessage%` | The message shown on the notification |

<small>Type id: `desktop.toastActivated`</small>
